newsitem.title: USA: Transitional Hospitals sells some operations.
newsitem.headline: Transitional Hospitals sells some operations.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp, formerly Community Psychiatric Centers, said it completed the sale of its U.S. psychiatric operations to Behavioral Healthcare Corp of Nashville for $60 million in cash plus stock and stock equivalents.
The stock and equivalent portion amounts to a 61 percent stake in Behavioral Healthcare, valued at about $70 million.
Transitional said sale of these operations will enhance its balance sheet. Including an expected tax refund, it will have about $120 million in cash and about $26 million in debt.
Transitional also said it will realize a tax benefit from the deal by offsetting a gain attributable to the sale of its U.K. psychiatric operations earlier in the year.
It said the psychiatric assets were sold at a loss between $10 and $20 million, thereby offsetting the gain from the U.K. sale.

Behavioral Healthcare plans to take the new combined company public as soon as market conditions permit. Following an initial public offering, Transitional said it plans to cut its stake in Behavioral to just under 20 percent.
